notes.title: Cavernreach Demo Patch 0.9.3 Update
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated to Demo v.0.9.3. This patch has fixed some bugs and a few improvements overall to the game/demo.

-Fix: Menu issues where escape would not exit the menu under certain circumstances
-Fix: Lighting issues / Light baking artifacts on geometry
-Fix: Game crashes due to certain users experiencing spikes in GPU workload due to texture memory consumption. Mostly due to the lighting/lightmap issues noted above.
-Fix: The UI now hides properly during dialogue

-------------

Update: UI improvements
Update: Added the ability to adjust the brightness/exposure in the Options menu
Update: Added some ground critters for game immersion
Update: Added some wildlife ambiant sounds for game immersion

notes.title: Dev Log #2
notes.notes:
As a solo dev, I'm doing my very best to make sure the game is worth it. I work daily on new things for the game, to make it the very best I can at release! Today, I thought I would share with all of you following the games development, the newest portion that is being worked on. The lava tubes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45610307/323243074dbfd6b460cfd2c2eac76868bf235195.png[/img]

Basically, this is a portion of the cave system that is old lava tubes, when the area was volcanically active. The tubes are an old reminder of the power of nature. You will be going into the old lava tubes, but make sure you have plenty of light (and a way to mark your path), because you could get lost and just end up going in circles, then your light will die, and so will you...

Make your way through the lava tubes, and see what lies on the other end! There is always something new around every corner, every squeeze, and every sump! While the games premise is basic, if you love to explore and see what you can find, I'm sure you will find enjoyment exploring Cavernreach and seeing what is deeper in the system, that has never been expored.

The bottom line - she goes!

But hey, I just wanted to share what's going on at Deep Rock Games and Cavernreach, and give a little sneak peak into what you can expect in the game. And before you memorize the screenshot of the lava tubes modeling, just know that there is much more twisty turny tubes being modeled now, so you will still need to keep up with your sense of direction!

If you are interested in Cavernreach thus far, make sure you wishlist it, and check back for new updates to the development. This isn't abandonware folks. I take great pride in this game! It's what I do in real life too! Explore, Explore, Explore!!!

notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Building the Cathedral Dome Cavern
notes.notes:
Hello explorers!

I'm thrilled to share a major milestone in the creation of my cave exploration game — the completion of one of the most breathtaking locations: The Cathedral Dome Cavern.

This vast, high-ceilinged chamber is one of the largest spaces in the cave system. As you step into it, you’ll feel the awe of standing in nature’s version of a cathedral — complete with a still, underground lake and massive stone formations that echo with ancient silence. Building this space was a joy, and it quickly became one of my favorite areas in the game.

It’s not just big — it’s majestic. Light plays off the rock in subtle ways, and as you look up into the dome, you’ll catch your breath at the scale and quiet beauty of it all. The ambient soundtrack here features soft, droning tones and haunting vocal harmonies to emphasize the emotional weight of the space. It’s meant to make you stop, listen, and just be for a moment.

This is the first of several key locations that will define your journey through the caves — each one unique, each one carefully crafted.

Thank you for following along with development. Wishlist the game if you haven’t yet — and stay tuned, because there’s much more to come.

— Cliff - Deep Rock Games
